comparisons.peer_summary: UTB balances affecting the effective tax rate were $573 million at December 31, 2024, with a possible decrease of up to $217 million in the next 12 months. The Corporation recognized an interest benefit of $9 million in 2024 and had accruals for interest and penalties of $105 million at year-end 2024.
comparisons.comparison: Both Citi and Bank of America disclose that significant changes in unrecognized tax benefits are reasonably possible within the next 12 months due to audits. However, Citi provides a specific quantitative range for the potential impact on its effective tax rate ($0 to $500 million), whereas Bank of America estimates a potential decrease in the total UTB balance of up to $217 million without specifying the corresponding impact on the effective tax rate.
